findings.description: The bucket is explicitly commented as public with no ACL restricting access, allowing unauthenticated or unintended users to read/write objects such as the customer-master.xlsx file stored in it.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects (including sensitive customer data) are stored unencrypted at rest.
